products.name: Descript Overdub
products.note: Voice cloning for editing; consent recording required; deepfake risk; media integrity

profile_text.body:
Descript is a for-profit startup founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as an AI video and audio editor built around a text-based editing model: users record or upload footage, the platform transcribes it automatically, and edits to the transcript, such as deleting a word or moving a sentence, apply directly to the corresponding video or audio. The company says the tool supports recording, transcribing, editing, and publishing within a single product.

Descript offers two tracked AI products. The first is its core editor, categorized under video generation and editing, which handles the text-driven editing workflow described above. The second is Descript Overdub, a voice cloning feature that allows users to generate synthetic versions of their own voice for editing purposes; the platform notes that consent recording is required and acknowledges deepfake and media integrity risks associated with the feature. The site also references an AI editing assistant called Underlord, which the company describes as capable of turning a raw recording into an edited cut without manual intervention.

The site's held facts show 175 legal exposure entries linked to California, though no specific cases are currently recorded. Descript has a profile page on the reference site and no listed MCP servers or SEC or patent filings in the held data.
